## Program Adherence And Prior-Work Recovery

This package follows the
[Citlali Scientific Contract Library Program](../../../README.md). Work began
with the package's [`PRIOR_WORK.md`](PRIOR_WORK.md) recovery record. The
candidate [`SCOPE_BRIEF.md`](SCOPE_BRIEF.md) identifies reusable material,
genuinely new work, proposed future author references, and information-firewall
exclusions.

The launch is an owner-directed roadmap change dated `2026-08-31`: SCI-FRUIT
now follows the completed single-pass MAP/JINC/NOI/filtering authority line and
precedes source-fitting and Pointing/OOF contracts. This ordering decision does
not answer a FRUIT scientific question and does not admit a parent route.

Recovery uses the exact SCI-FLT-FIXED conditional-freeze record at the launch
base. The provisional matched-filter recovery study is inspected only at exact
commit `faff97565ee27e375e1337febe5a0a6681507c3b`, tree
`0dfa3cdfa8a261bd00878cafd593aafb87394163`; it remains read-only, provisional,
and non-authoritative. No later state of that study is in scope.

## Purpose

SCI-FRUIT will own the scientific meaning of an iterative map-to-timestream
feedback procedure. Before scientific authorship can begin, Stage A must
separate and type:

- the immutable reduction parent and the feedback-model product;
- source/model selection from map estimation;
- forward projection, subtraction, residual processing, add-back/rejoin, and
  model transition;
- fixed policy, learned state, apply state, observation-resolved state, and
  realized products;
- iteration, generation, terminal, checkpoint, restart, and branch identity;
- response, null space, covariance/uncertainty, support, validity, and failure;
  and
- diagnostic convergence from an owner-approved stopping rule.

A map-shaped object is not automatically a feedback sky model. Neither a
current implementation path nor historical empirical stability supplies the
missing scientific contract.

## Principal Recovery Results

1. The historical program inventory correctly assigned recurrence, feedback,
   final-pass identity, restart, and delivered-parent relation to SCI-FRUIT,
   but it supplied no approved contract.
2. Current scientific conventions establish absolute zero-based iteration
   identity and exact-restart versus map-only seed semantics. They do not
   establish the scientific update law, convergence rule, or parent admission.
3. The historical studies provide useful evidence that amplitude, morphology,
   centroid, map change, support/learning, and noise behavior can disagree.
   They do not establish a universal correction or stopping threshold.
4. Ordinary MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, and provisional FLT-MATCHED are four distinct
   candidate parent routes. At this Stage A snapshot every numerical route is
   unavailable, for route-specific reasons recorded in the admission matrix.
5. The exact historical numerical predecessor is one selected complete raw or
   filtered observation/coadd map bundle. Each next iteration rereads the
   original observation, derives and subtracts a selected projected model,
   processes the residual, restores the accepted model after residual-only
   operations, and maps a new complete route product. No explicit increment
   accumulation is present in the recovered transition.
6. Ordinary additive accumulation is not established as equivalent. Equality
   requires route-specific proofs for projection/remapping, response, support,
   WCS/grid, weighting, normalization, masks, filtering, and learning; several
   conditions are unavailable and historical add-back support can differ after
   residual flag changes.
7. Carried-state identity, transition law, update-contribution status, and
   persistence are separate decisions. A named contribution is not
   automatically a calibrated sky product and stable identity does not require
   permanent retention of all intermediates.
8. Exact restart must restore all operational state that can change future
   scientific output. Diagnostic history is not automatically operational
   state, and a map-only seed is a new generation rather than continuation.
9. Fixed-state uncertainty, successor-generation learning, and per-realization
   replay are distinct NOI methods and must not be pooled without separate
   owner authority.

## Stop Rule

Do not create or dispatch an implementation-blind author packet until the
scientific owner has reviewed the recovery record and answered the ordered
questions in [`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md`](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md)
through the packet-admission gate. In particular, do not treat the candidate
scope, proposed recurrence graph, current implementation, or empirical studies
as scientific authority. The revised first question offers only three honest
treatments: preserve the recovered recurrence, prove and validate an equivalent
reformulation, or intentionally adopt and validate a new recurrence.

## Explicit Nonclaims

This package changes no algorithm or frozen/approved adjacent authority. It
makes no claim of implementation conformity, numerical availability,
calibration, response or covariance fidelity, convergence, stopping validity,
uncertainty completeness, achieved performance, readiness, production
authorization, or Unity activity. It neither approves SCI-FLT-MATCHED nor
modifies its provisional study.
